description: This file defines the CritterIconRenderer enum which includes methods and internal structures for rendering a critter icon as an NSImage with various customizable features such as face expressions, ears, legs, and badges. It handles icon generation, drawing components on a canvas, and managing rendering details.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Generates an NSImage icon of a critter with options for blinking, leg wiggle, ear wiggle, ear scale, ear holes, eyes closed lines, and an optional badge. It creates a bitmap representation, draws the critter's body and face, and overlays a badge if provided.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Creates a 36x36 pixel bitmap image representation for high-resolution, retina-friendly icons.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Initializes a Canvas structure with scaled step sizes and snapping functions based on the bitmap rep.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the critter's body, ears, and legs onto the provided canvas context.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the critter's face, including eyes, eye holes, and blinking expressions, with options for closed eyes and holes.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Draws a badge icon with different prominence states onto the canvas, including a background puck and symbol.
